description: At session start, names the folder's plugin profile, the entries that differ from it, plugins installed since it was applied, an unfinished switch and the surface; prints nothing in a folder with no applied profile unless the session was resumed without the profile it ran in, records the profile a one-session start runs in by session id, reads installed plugins from disk and never starts a nested claude. The module answers /plugin-profile, the in-session switch, and runs its one /reload-plugins when the turn ends.
